_comment: Tier-0 mock dialogue templates (gdd-npc-dialogue.md §13.9). Keyed by move -> outcome -> attitude-band, with a per-move default and a global fallback. Because must_say content is engine-generated (NpcReplyPlan), these are informationally complete (§13.9). Slots: {npc_name}, {speaker_name}, {new_attitude}. The renderer (DialogueTemplateProvider) fills slots from the reply plan. Terse by design; the game is fully playable offline on these.

shared.any: {npc_name} leans in. "Here's a thing worth knowing: {rumor_text}"

default.any: {npc_name} considers, then shares what they've heard.

shift_toward_friendly.indifferent: {npc_name} relents a little. "Perhaps we can deal."

shift_toward_hostile.hostile: {npc_name}'s face darkens. "You've said the wrong thing."

no_change.any: {npc_name} is unmoved. Their manner is unchanged ({new_attitude}).

shift_toward_friendly.cowed: {npc_name} pales and submits. "Whatever you say — just don't hurt me."
shift_toward_friendly.fearful: {npc_name} flinches, eyes darting for the exit.

shift_toward_hostile.hostile: {npc_name} bares teeth. "Threaten me? Then we're done talking."

to_hostile.hostile: {npc_name} snaps. "That's the last insult I'll take from you!" — and reaches for a weapon.

no_knowledge.any: {npc_name} spreads their hands. "On that, I can't help you."

not_trusted.any: {npc_name} shakes their head. "I don't know you well enough to speak of that."

wants_payment.any: {npc_name} rubs thumb and fingers together. "Knowledge like that has a price."

refused.any: {npc_name}'s mouth sets in a line. "I'll not speak of it."

bribed.any: {npc_name} pockets the coin, manner easing. "Well — since you ask so kindly."

accept_elan.any: {npc_name} grins and clasps {speaker_name}'s hand. "Aye — gladly! When do we ride?"

accept.any: {npc_name} nods. "Your terms suit me. I'll take service."

try_again.any: {npc_name} hesitates. "Sweeten the deal and we'll talk."

refuse.any: {npc_name} shakes their head. "Not on those terms."

refuse_slander.any: {npc_name} sneers and turns away. "I'd not serve the likes of you — and I'll say as much to any who ask."

accept.any: {npc_name} inclines their head. "Agreed. My services are yours."

try_again.any: {npc_name} purses their lips. "The fee will need to be higher."

refuse_slander.any: {npc_name} bristles. "I'll not work for you — and others will hear why."

accept_elan.any: {npc_name} the captain slaps the table. "My company's yours — and glad of the work!"

accept.any: {npc_name} the captain nods. "We'll take your coin and your contract."

try_again.any: {npc_name} the captain folds their arms. "My lads won't march for that. Better terms."

refuse_slander.any: {npc_name} spits. "We don't soldier for the likes of you."

default.any: {speaker_name} makes the rounds, listening for word worth having.
